tei:div.tei:p: )))dam chos rta mgrin snying thig snying po don sbyor gyi spra khrid bar do'i gsol 'debs byin rlabs kyi snying po can bzhugs so: oṃ āḥhūm̐: dmigs med spros dang bral ba'i pho brang nas: chos sku kun bzang yab yum la gsol ba 'debs: lhun grub 'od lnga 'khrigs pa'i pho brang nas: longs sku zhi khro yab yum la gsol ba 'debs: thugs rje phyogs ris med pa'i pho brang nas: sprul sku rdo rje 'chang chen la gsol ba 'debs: dur khrod me ri 'bar ba'i pho brang nas: ston pa rdo rje sems dpa' la gsol ba 'debs: snang sems 'dzin pa bral ba'i pho brang nas: rig 'dzin dga' rab rdo rje la gsol ba 'debs: dpal ri padma 'od kyi pho brang nas: o rgyan yab yum gnyis la gsol ba 'debs: snang srid bde chen rol pa'i pho brang nas: sprul sku chos blo mgon po la gsol ba 'debs: rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs ston pa'i pho brang nas: grub chen mchog ldan rdo rje la gsol ba 'debs: spyi gtsug nyi zla padma'i gdan steng nas: drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma la gsol ba 'debs: brag dkar lha chu gter gnas kyi pho brang nas: dam chos snying po don sbyor la gsol ba 'debs: rang lus dag pa lha yi pho brang nas: yi dam rta phag yab yum la gsol ba 'debs: dag snang phyogs ris med pa'i pho brang nas: chos mdzad gong ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs: rang lus 'khor lo lnga yi pho brang nas: dpa' bo ḍākki'i tshogs bcas la gsol ba 'debs: sha khrag rgya mtsho 'khyil ba'i pho brang nas: bka' srung ma mo'i tshogs bcas la gsol ba 'debs: dam tshig gsang ba mchog gi pho brang nas: gter srung dam can rgya mtsho la gsol ba 'debs: nged gsol 'debs kyi bu slob thams cad la: nam zhig lus sems 'bral ba'i dus kyi tshe: 'pho chen bcu gnyis rtsa 'dab rim gyis skem: rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rtog pa re zhig 'gag: 'jigs pa'i snang ba sna tshogs shar ba'i tshe:

rang snang zhi khro'i tshogs la ma 'jigs shig: bla ma'i man ngag dran par byin gyis rlobs: 'byung ba thim zhing dbang po thim pa dang : rnam rtog thim zhing phra rags thim pa'i tshe: 'chi ba 'od gsal chos sku'i gnas lugs la: dran pas myur du zin par byin gyis rlobs: zla ba thur babs dkar lam shes pa 'byung : zhe sdang las gyur rtog pa so gsum 'gag: nyi ma gyen 'gro'i dmar lam shes pa 'byung : 'dod chags las gyur rtog pa bzhi bcu 'gag: srin bu me khyer lta bu'i nyams snang 'char: de nyid chos skur zin par byin gyis rlobs: khyab byed 'khyug pas nag lam shes pa 'byung : gti mug las gyur rtog pa rim bdun 'gag: rang snang 'od gsal zin par byin gyis rlobs: las rlung 'gyu ba'i nus pa zad pa'i tshe: gzhan snang 'gag nas gzung 'dzin kun dang bral: sems nyid skye med kun tu bzang po de: 'chi ba 'od gsal chos sku'i pho brang bzhugs: 'od gsal ma bu mjal bar byin gyis rlobs: gal te las dbang bar do myong gyur na: de ma thag tu skye med dran byas nas: gzung 'dzin rang sar grol bar byin gyis rlobs: 'jigs rung gshin rje'i snang ba shar ba'i tshe: sems kyi rang snang yin par rtogs nas kyang : skye med dbyings su thim par byin gyis rlobs: sa chu me rlung log pa'i rtags bzhi dang : 'jigs snang bzhi dang ma nges rtags drug 'char: snang srid 'khor 'das chos skur thag chod nas: bar do 'od gsal ma bu mjal ba dang : gnas lugs gcig tu 'dres par byin gyis rlobs: ces khrid kyi dus sam: 'chi ba'i mtshams sbyor gyi dus gdangs snyan pos gsol ba rtags ma byung bar gdab par bya'o: rdzogs so: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: zhes gsol ba btab pa'i rjes su smon lam ni/ kye ma/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro khyed rnams la// de ltar rtse gcig gsol ba btab pa'i mthus// zab don bsgom la bar chad mi 'byung zhing*// rlung sems rang dbang thob par byin gyis rlobs// ma dag rnam smin lus 'di bor ma thag
/rnam dag bde ba can du skye ba dang*// 'od dpag med kyi thugs dang dbyer med nas// padma dbang gi 'phrin las 'dzin par shog /ces gdab par bya'o/// /
